scope: Targeted original reports/code beyond the earlier ten-page audit; not a systematic literature review.

sources.population: Age18, PA150, all attributes12, 180cm/70kg; coaches16, facilities20.
sources.design: One attribute set to1,6,18; preset Gegenpress424/442; five opponent formations,100 matches each over12 months; FMRTE state locks.
sources.raw_access: Attribute workbook linked at https://pixeldrain.com/u/oR2hwoSU; not downloaded; granularity/hash/license unknown.
sources.finding: Direct primary source behind downstream attribute guides; this is not our isolated raw60→80 estimand.
sources.uncertainty: No job-level variance or confidence interval audited; author notes limited/rushed sampling.
sources.position_scope: No native mask manifest; one preset IP424/OOP442. Constancy of attribute values during the season is not established by the page.

sources.population: Ten saved fixtures from one newly promoted EPL club; real squads, bench and assistant/AI management.
sources.design: All tested-side squad members receive ±25 stored attribute points, clamped;300 matched fixture/seed pairs per contrast.
sources.rng: Ten fixtures × seeds1..30; same fixtures previously used on27.0.
sources.cluster: Fixed fixture-conditioned RNG precision differs from club/fixture generalization.
sources.finding: Baseline is accessible; whole-squad/clamped dose and live tactics differ from our starter-only D00.
sources.uncertainty: Previous-build correlation is internal reuse, not independent external replication.
sources.position_scope: Stored real-squad positions; full-squad dose, no complete published native mask/readback inventory audited.

sources.population: A: real squads/ten real fixtures; B: same fixtures, both squads attributes12; C: one bundled synthetic sample.
sources.design: 300 paired plus/minus contrasts per attribute; result is half the difference, representing+5 display points by author convention.
sources.rng: A/B:30 seeds per fixture; C:300 seeds on one fixture.
sources.cluster: A/B versus C changes masks, body, tactics, fixture and start state together.
sources.finding: Real-fixture versus synthetic estimates differ materially; positions alone are not isolated.
sources.uncertainty: Rounded mean/t allow approximate marginal SD reconstruction only; no cross-attribute covariance or raw pairs.
sources.position_scope: A/B retain real-fixture positions; C sets every position natural, alongside other setup changes.

sources.population: Ten real fixtures, natural sharpness mostly90–100; assistant-managed squads.
sources.design: Code jointly sets sharpness and sharpness_secondary to5000/7500/10000 for every active squad member, including goalkeeper/bench.
sources.rng: Screen seeds1..30 per fixture; selected sharpness100% confirmation31..120.
sources.cluster: Repeated real fixtures, natural comparator; selected internal confirmation.
sources.finding: 100% confirmation reports+0.10 points,+0.11xGD; not our7000→10000 ten-starting-outfield raw package.
sources.uncertainty: 50%/75% effects are screen results; labels do not calibrate our FM UI or cache semantics.
sources.position_scope: Stored real-squad positions; joint state intervention covers active squad including GK and bench.

sources.population: Synthetic EPL middle-eight squads; Gegenpress424; four opponents, both sides, two templates; familiarity80.
sources.design: Starter attributes jointly randomized±5 with clamping; position-sum regression and split-half filter.
sources.rng: Source assigns setting=c%16 and engine seed=floor(c/16)+1:3,125 numeric seeds over50,000 configurations.
sources.cluster: Repeated numeric seed is neither proof of identical events nor proof of correlation; sampling/cluster justification remains open.
sources.finding: Independent-author attempt to compare with Purity; raw replication not verified.
sources.uncertainty: OLS uses homoskedastic covariance; no explicit cluster covariance found. Split-half |t|>2 is not multiplicity-controlled external confirmation.
sources.position_scope: Starter positional groups ST/AM/DM/FB/CB and GK; synthetic squads, not a randomized unused-mask experiment.

sources.population: Synthetic EPL middle-eight squads, Gegenpress, familiarity80; fixed templates/opponents.
sources.design: Thirteen attributes at1,3,6,9,12,15,18,20; shared unchanged baseline;200 paired observations per level.
sources.cluster: Shared baselines correlated across doses; author uses GLS.
sources.finding: Author finds different JR/speed dose-response shapes; motivates baseline×dose inquiry, not universal knees.
sources.uncertainty: Knees searched across candidate locations; exploratory and context-bound, without independent raw reanalysis.
sources.position_scope: Synthetic preset positions; no isolated positional manipulation.

sources.population: Five EPL strength pairings, median CA approximately148/138/131; fixed familiarity80.
sources.design: Ten whole-squad attributes+5 versus unchanged baseline;160 pairs per condition.
sources.rng: Matched context/seed comparisons; complete raw seed manifest not audited.
sources.cluster: Narrow top-to-bottom EPL strength range; context generalization limited.
sources.finding: No detected heterogeneity does not establish equivalent attribute values across strengths.
sources.uncertainty: Author reports approximately±0.15xPts resolution; do not discard strength interactions on non-rejection.
sources.position_scope: Synthetic preset positions; no isolated positional manipulation.

sources.design: Resumable chunk runner; missing/failed match advances cursor and continues; paired analyses intersect available keys.
sources.rng: Resume identity includes experiment/condition/seed; fixture identity encoded in condition.
sources.cluster: Failure/omission accounting requires original jobs, results and logs.
sources.finding: Code permits incomplete available-pair analysis; this is a reproducibility risk, not evidence that a reported run actually failed.
sources.uncertainty: No tracked raw JSONL/job ledger found at reviewed commit; historical runtime or exclusions not reconstructed.
sources.position_scope: Generic study protocol; positional setup is delegated to study builders.

sources.author_build: Multiple Steam/GamePass build notes; exact sharpness-test build unknown
sources.population: Live career-player memory under Proton; no controlled outcome study.
sources.design: Original notes explicitly classify condition/sharpness/fatigue as unverified or broken; observed UI words do not establish raw calibration.
sources.finding: Independent technical observations, not performance replication and not MATCH_PLAYER cache validation.
sources.uncertainty: Career-player offsets cannot establish our raw start-package scale, cache consumer or match effect.
sources.position_scope: Live PLAYER structure; not verified MATCH_PLAYER phase/cache correspondence.

repository_inventory.scope_limit: Current tracked Git tree only; releases, ignored private files and offsite data not exhaustively inventoried.
repository_inventory.software_license: MIT; grant does not relicense game-derived inputs/data.

summary_arithmetic.formula: SE=abs(rounded_mean/rounded_t); SD=SE*sqrt(300). Rounding ranges assume displayed mean±0.005 and t±0.05, not sampling confidence intervals.
summary_arithmetic.endpoint: xGD; half of paired plus-minus difference representing+5 author-display points
cannot_reconstruct: covariance between JR, Acceleration and Pace
